info.title: fspure-collector
info.description: Generate PureFile (.pure.json) pure-method whitelists from managed assemblies for fspure / FSharp.PureAnalyzer.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: fspure-collector – generate a PureFile (.pure.json) whitelist from managed assemblies. Optionally merge author-supplied pure.json files via --merge-with.

options.name: --report
options.description: Optional path for a detailed List A JSON report

options.name: -a
options.description: Assembly path(s) to analyze (repeatable). Required unless --defaults is used.

options.name: --merge-with
options.description: Additional .pure.json file(s) to merge after collection (repeatable). Union of pureMethods; when the same fullName appears more than once, the last file wins. Escape hatch for methods the Core-centric heuristics miss.

options.name: --defaults
options.description: Include the default foundational assembly set (FSharp.Core + core BCL)

options.name: --public-only
options.description: Only emit publicly visible pure methods

options.name: --verbose-report
options.description: Include per-method diagnostics in the report
